Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting sale of alcohol on ferries.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to alcoholic beverages on ferries; and adding a newsection to chapter 47.60 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.60 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The legislature finds that the public health, safety, andwelfare require that the sale and consumption of alcoholic beverages beprohibited on state ferries. (2) It is unlawful to sell or consume alcoholic beverages on stateferries. The department shall post signs to this effect at all ferryterminals and on all vessels.
